name: work camp in Nepal
source:
This is a diary about my journey as a member of my school’s 2004 Nepal Work Camp. I took all the photos on-site, and heavily revised and expanded the diary entries using the notes I scribbled during the trip. I didn't change any of the names of places I mention, though there may exist slight variations in pronunciation. Please bear with me.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/371]freem[/url]]
translation:
這是一部記錄我作為學校2004年尼泊爾國際志工營一員的旅行日記。所有照片均由我在當地實地拍攝，日記正文則根據旅途中隨手記下的筆記進行了大幅修改與擴充。文中提及的地名均保留原樣，但讀音上可能存在些許出入，敬請包涵。

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/371]freem[/url]]
